steps.text: (function(){var b=document.body?document.body.innerText:'';var loggedOut=/log in|sign up|continue with google/i.test(b.slice(0,400));var ce=document.querySelectorAll('div[contenteditable="true"]');var pm=document.querySelectorAll('.ProseMirror');var send=[];document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){var al=x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'';if(/send|submit/i.test(al))send.push(al)});return 'url='+location.href.slice(0,50)+' | loggedOut='+loggedOut+' | contenteditable='+ce.length+' | proseMirror='+pm.length+' | sendBtns=['+send.slice(0,4).join(',')+'] | head='+b.slice(0,90).replace(/\n/g,' / ')})()
